svg.text: Repeatable metal locator dock · component preview
25 actual CAD solids. Supporting grid and metal carrier are integration requirements.
One round pin + one diamond pin locate XY. Separate seats and drawbolts carry table loads.
Hard Z datum: +14; fixed pin block top: +12
2 mm separation keeps pin shoulder off Z datum
Grid top: 0; full support required beneath blocks
Local geometric checks pass. Not an integrated bed, supplier-certified model, or measured repeatability guarantee.
